decisions.scope: Malformed API link PATCH URLs, app link whitespace normalization, and malformed app link bodies or URL types

target_result.api_patch: Reject malformed URLs with HTTP400 url=[Enter a valid URL.] before domain writes and crawl/activity tasks; preserve normal API token use and audit. Valid URLs retain URLValidator length2048 and no model200-character cap.
target_result.app_whitespace: Trim surrounding whitespace before adding a missing http scheme; an existing link PATCH succeeds with the normalized URL and ordinary persistence/crawl/activity effects. Preserve the original request data in the activity payload.
target_result.app_non_object: Return HTTP400 with the ordinary dictionary validation error for array or string bodies before any domain write or task, instead of the source AttributeError500. Raw null keeps the source HTTP400 No data provided response.
target_result.compression_vary: Derive only the Accept-Encoding Vary token from the target response representation; keep all other source headers and cookies exact.
target_result.app_url_type: Return HTTP400 with the ordinary invalid-URL error for a numeric URL and invalid-string error for an object URL before any domain write or task, instead of the source AttributeError500.
